DESIGN_SYSTEM §3 maps Toggle/Toggle-group to `.anat-keys button`, `.spot-line`, `.path-btn` with aria-pressed = filled + a word/mark + pressed shadow. (crops deleted after the review to save disk; regenerate with tools/check_chapter.js --shots or tools/review/visual-scripts/audit.js)
fix: Before `.btn[aria-pressed=true] { outline: 3px solid ink }` → After: render the chips as `.path-btn` (engine toggle) and drop both rules, or keep .btn and use `box-shadow: var(--shadow-hard-sm); transform: translate(2px,2px)` plus a '✓' (why: an on state must not mimic the focus ring; state never by colour alone).
